FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions

What AI models are available?

BlivoAI supports multiple powerful AI models. You can switch between models at any time during your conversations to get the best results for each task. Free users have access to free models, while Basic and Pro plans unlock premium models with advanced capabilities including image generation and advanced coding assistance.

How does the token limit work?

Each plan has a monthly token limit that determines how much you can chat. The Free plan includes 5,000 tokens per month, Basic offers 50,000 tokens, and Pro provides 100,000 tokens. Tokens are consumed based on the length of your messages and AI responses. Limits reset at the beginning of each billing cycle, and you can upgrade anytime for more capacity.

Is my data private and secure?

Yes, absolutely. All conversations on BlivoAI are encrypted and stored securely. We never share your data with third parties, and you can delete your conversations at any time. Our platform uses enterprise-grade security measures including encrypted connections, secure authentication, and strict access controls to protect your information.

Can I generate images with BlivoAI?

Yes! Image generation is available on the Pro plan. Simply ask BlivoAI to create an image in any language, and it will automatically generate it for you using advanced AI image models. You can request images in natural language, such as 'create an image of a sunset' or 'اعملي صورة قطة', and the system handles the rest seamlessly.

How do I upgrade my plan?

You can upgrade your plan at any time by clicking the 'Upgrade Now' button on the pricing section or from your account settings. The upgrade takes effect immediately, and you'll get instant access to all new features including premium models, code generation, sandbox, and image generation on the Pro plan. Payments are processed securely through trusted payment providers.

What happens if I reach my token limit?

When you reach your monthly token limit, you'll be notified and won't be able to send new messages until the next billing cycle or until you upgrade your plan. We also send a warning when you're approaching your limit so you can plan accordingly. Upgrading your plan gives you immediate access to more tokens.
